name: BRAX Brazilian chest films (PhysioNet)
what: 40,967 chest radiographs from 24,959 studies at Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, Sao Paulo, Brazil, frontal and lateral views, labelled with 14 radiological findings
level_truth: none; laterals show the thoracic spine
licence: PhysioNet credentialed access (the licence line read on the project page)
how_to_get: The owner signs the project's data use agreement at https://physionet.org/content/brax/ (the Files section); PhysioNet may then hold access until it has reviewed his CITI course record, as it does for MIMIC-CXR.
Then the files are fetched as a Slurm job with the owner's PhysioNet credentials read from ~/.netrc, never from a command line, and checked against the project's SHA256SUMS.txt.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; PhysioNet credentialed access (Scientific Data 2022, PMC9364309); 24,959 studies and 40,967 images, frontal and lateral, from Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, Sao Paulo
